title: AI Engineer (m/f/d)
description: We’re looking for an engineer who builds AI systems that create real impact in production (not just demos) and has worked with retrieval or agent-based approaches on enterprise data. At Natuvion, we move business-critical data and processes between platforms. This data enables powerful AI — but also comes with complexity, sensitivity, and high stakes. We use AI to automate internal processes and to build intelligent features into our products, and you’ll work across both areas. We operate with strictly protected data that is never exposed to external LLMs, supported by a strong authorization model. Self-hosted models are an important part of our strategy. Our core stack is built in Go with gRPC-based services, including a custom AI router. While AI work may start in Python, production services are built in Go — and you’ll own them end-to-end. We deliberately stay flexible with our AI stack. The field evolves quickly, and we value engineers who stay current, think critically, and bring ideas to the table. This role focuses on building robust, production-grade systems designed to be operated, evaluated, and improved over time. We’re looking for someone who prioritizes maintainability, thoughtful evaluation, and chooses the right tool for the job. If that excites you, we’d love to hear from you. Your Responsibilities: Design, build, and operate RAG solutions across the full spectrum — from semantic search through to retrieval over highly structured data and knowledge graphs  Build agentic systems that perform multi-step tasks reliably and safely against enterprise data  Drive automation of internal processes with AI, and ship AI features into customer-facing products  Own retrieval quality end to end: chunking and embedding strategies, hybrid and re-ranking approaches, and the evaluation that proves it works  Evaluate and recommend the tooling for our AI stack — vector stores, orchestration, retrieval frameworks, model choices — and drive those decisions together with our architect. raw.title: AI Engineer (m/f/d)
raw.description:
We’re looking for an engineer who builds AI systems that create real impact in production (not just demos) and has worked with retrieval or agent-based approaches on enterprise data.

At Natuvion, we move business-critical data and processes between platforms. This data enables powerful AI — but also comes with complexity, sensitivity, and high stakes. We use AI to automate internal processes and to build intelligent features into our products, and you’ll work across both areas.

We operate with strictly protected data that is never exposed to external LLMs, supported by a strong authorization model. Self-hosted models are an important part of our strategy.

Our core stack is built in Go with gRPC-based services, including a custom AI router. While AI work may start in Python, production services are built in Go — and you’ll own them end-to-end.

We deliberately stay flexible with our AI stack. The field evolves quickly, and we value engineers who stay current, think critically, and bring ideas to the table.

This role focuses on building robust, production-grade systems designed to be operated, evaluated, and improved over time. We’re looking for someone who prioritizes maintainability, thoughtful evaluation, and chooses the right tool for the job.

If that excites you, we’d love to hear from you.

Your Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and operate RAG solutions across the full spectrum — from semantic search through to retrieval over highly structured data and knowledge graphs 

  • Build agentic systems that perform multi-step tasks reliably and safely against enterprise data 

  • Drive automation of internal processes with AI, and ship AI features into customer-facing products 

  • Own retrieval quality end to end: chunking and embedding strategies, hybrid and re-ranking approaches, and the evaluation that proves it works 

  • Evaluate and recommend the tooling for our AI stack — vector stores, orchestration, retrieval frameworks, model choices — and drive those decisions together with our architect. We expect informed proposals, not a wait for instructions 

  • Author production services in Go (gRPC) and integrate them with our AI router and existing platform; prototype and iterate in Python 

  • Make grounded technical decisions — retrieval vs. fine-tuning vs. prompting vs. a classical approach — and defend the trade-offs in architectural reviews 


  • You hold a degree in Business Informatics or Computer Science

  • You have several years of experience, a strong Python proficiency for AI development, and genuine comfort working in Go — you're 100% willing and able to author production gRPC services, not just call them 

  • A proven track record of building AI features on enterprise data that actually shipped and stayed in production 

  • Real understanding of the fundamentals behind modern RAG: embeddings and vector similarity, retrieval and ranking, and how transformer-based models behave. You reason about why a pipeline succeeds or fails — you don't guess 

  • Hands-on experience designing and evaluating retrieval and agentic systems, including building your own metrics and eval rather than trusting vibes 

  • Experience with knowledge graphs or structured/semantic data representations is a strong plus 

  • Curiosity that shows: ideally you've fine-tuned a small model yourself (LoRA / QLoRA or similar) and understand the basics of what's happening under the hood 

  • You stay genuinely current in a fast-moving field and hold reasoned opinions. You can walk into a discussion with our architect with a concrete recommendation and defend the trade-offs — and change your mind when the evidence says so 

  • Comfortable in cloud-native environments — you think about observability, failure modes, and cost as first-class concerns 

  • Professional working proficiency in English — you can explain complex technical ideas clearly to peers and stakeholders 

If you think that you don't meet all the requirements: With us, there are "no limits" to your development! Go your way with us - we support you! Just show us who you are.

An environment that is always open to change and optimization. There is no "it's always been like this" with us. You have the opportunity to contribute your knowledge, design processes, standardize existing topics or optimize workflows. Be a source of inspiration and bring us even further forward with your expertise!

We create conditions in which you feel comfortable:

  • Home office contracts & absolute flexibility through free organization of working hours

  • Permanent position and 30 days of vacation

  • FlexWork: Work remotely from other European countries for up to 3 months per year

  • Monthly budget for individually selectable benefits from over 50 possible offers via emplu, various offers via corporate benefits, as well as bicycle and car leasing via salary conversion

  • Mental Health Benefit 'Nilo' – 10 free sessions with psychologists annually as well as access to meditations and courses

  • We provide you with targeted support in your professional and personal development at Natuvion

  • Mentoring program for a structured and personal induction

  • Be part of the #teamgreen - At Natuvion, you'll work on innovative projects as part of a team that stands up for each other. We rely on cooperation, openness and trust

  • Modern equipment and central offices in Walldorf, Berlin, Munich and Leipzig

  • Your long-term perspective is important to us, which is why we subsidize your company pension scheme as well as capital-forming benefits

title: Brand & Content Lead
description: In Short: We are looking for someone that loves content and eCommerce to own our entire brand surface — content, community, product marketing, and website — and turn Klar into the go-to resource for actionable eCom knowledge in Europe. About Klar 🚀 The Mission Klar is the Data Operating System for growing eCommerce companies, meaning no more spreadsheets . We integrate with all of a brand's data sources to provide a holistic understanding of their business, offering detailed insights on how to accelerate growth and increase profitability. 🛍️ The Reach We are already the "single source of truth" for over 1,000 leading eCom brands. Market leaders like Sunday Natural, Loop Earplugs, Holy, Maniko, and Armed Angels use Klar to make better decisions every single day. 🤝 The Backstory We deeply empathize with our customers because we were our customers. The founders (who met in South Africa working for Zando) spent the last 10 years in e-commerce. We know the pain of running these businesses, and we built Klar specifically to solve it. ✨ The Principle Our guiding principle is Do Work You Are Proud Of . We emphasize long-term quality over short-term results. We evaluate our tools and decisions wisely because we want to be proud of what we build together. Tasks About The Position Klar has two big assets outside of our software: the content we produce and the eCom Unity, Germany's largest eCommerce community with 2,500+ active operators. Both are running today — but honestly, neither is running at the level it could. That's where you come in. You will own our brand end-to-end and build it into a well-oiled machine. Concretely, that means four areas: 1. The Content Engine We are in the early stages of building a scalable, consistent content operation, and you will play a major role in deciding what it becomes. You will own the overall direction, identify which formats and channels we should double down on, and turn them into a content engine that ships reliably and at a high bar. Here is what we are currently thinking: A weekly newsletter that shares the biggest knowledge bombs from our community, workshops, and own research — no fluff, operational insights only. A podcast and/or YouTube channel where we go deep with the best operators in eCom on how they actually grow their businesses. Not “here is our founding story” — straight to the operational meat. Personal branding on LinkedIn for our founders and team members. You will build the system, develop the angles, and yes — write in other people’s voices. If ghostwriting feels beneath you, this is not your role. You will already have a Content & Video Producer on your team, who is also happy to jump in front of the camera and take ownership beyond production. Together, you will orchestrate the content process from idea to distribution. We work AI-first - a well-set-up Claude gets you 90% of a draft; your judgment, taste, and editing get it to 100%. 2. Community & Events The eCom Unity runs 20+ IRL events per year like our pre-OMR meetup with 150 operators and a bunch of online workshops. Two people on the team run this today, and it's largely on autopilot — your job is to guide them, connect the community to the content engine (every event is content, every discussion is a newsletter), and push the eCom Unity into its next phase as a genuine media asset. 3. Product Marketing How we talk about Klar — our positioning, our messaging, and our anti-hype stance in a market full of hype — is something you will own and shape. You will be the strategic counterpart to Max, our founder, who is deeply opinionated on this. Your role is to challenge his perspective, sharpen our thinking, and translate a complex product into clear, compelling messaging that makes its value immediately obvious. 4. Website & Sales Collateral You own our website (Webflow) and the collateral our sales team needs. You should be able to execute most of this yourself — with Figma, Webflow, and AI tools like Claude Code — and pull in engineering or freelancers when needed. What success looks like after 12 months: a content machine that ships consistently and at high quality, a growing audience (newsletter, community, social) that considers Klar one of the go-to resources for eCom knowledge in Europe — and a measurable content contribution to our pipeline. Requirements About You You are among the best at what you do - we are looking for extraordinarily talented people who are looking to take their career and knowledge to the next level. You likely have 5–10 years of experience across content, brand, or product marketing. You are smart & naturally curious - existing in-depth knowledge of eCommerce would be ideal, of course, but we understand that this might be a stretch. Thus, you need to be excited to dig into new industries and gain knowledge of the brands, people and operations in it. You are a great writer and editor - most content starts as words. You write excellent copy in English (German is a plus), and you have the taste to take an AI-generated draft from good to great. You know the difference. You are a builder, not just a strategist - you don't need a team of ten to ship. You're comfortable in Webflow, Figma, and AI tools, and you'd rather publish this week than perfect a strategy deck. You lead through others - you'll guide our community team and work with our video editor. You don't need formal authority to get people moving. You optimize for learning - your main motivation at this point of your career is to learn as much as possible and broaden your tool set. You want to work with people of the same mindset and learn from each other. Location : Munich preferred, remote possible. Benefits Our Offer 💰 Top-of-Market Compensation We want to hire the best people out there to help make Klar successful, and we ensure you are compensated accordingly. 🕊️ Freedom & Impact You will work with founders who truly "get" eCom and are super interested in your ideas. raw.title: Brand & Content Lead
raw.description:
In Short: We are looking for someone that loves content and eCommerce to own our entire brand surface — content, community, product marketing, and website — and turn Klar into the go-to resource for actionable eCom knowledge in Europe.

About Klar

🚀 The Mission

Klar is the Data Operating System for growing eCommerce companies, meaning no more spreadsheets. We integrate with all of a brand's data sources to provide a holistic understanding of their business, offering detailed insights on how to accelerate growth and increase profitability.

🛍️ The Reach

We are already the "single source of truth" for over 1,000 leading eCom brands. Market leaders like Sunday Natural, Loop Earplugs, Holy, Maniko, and Armed Angels use Klar to make better decisions every single day.

🤝 The Backstory

We deeply empathize with our customers because we were our customers. The founders (who met in South Africa working for Zando) spent the last 10 years in e-commerce. We know the pain of running these businesses, and we built Klar specifically to solve it.

✨ The Principle

Our guiding principle is Do Work You Are Proud Of. We emphasize long-term quality over short-term results. We evaluate our tools and decisions wisely because we want to be proud of what we build together.

Tasks

About The Position

Klar has two big assets outside of our software: the content we produce and the eCom Unity, Germany's largest eCommerce community with 2,500+ active operators. Both are running today — but honestly, neither is running at the level it could. That's where you come in.

You will own our brand end-to-end and build it into a well-oiled machine. Concretely, that means four areas:

1. The Content Engine

We are in the early stages of building a scalable, consistent content operation, and you will play a major role in deciding what it becomes. You will own the overall direction, identify which formats and channels we should double down on, and turn them into a content engine that ships reliably and at a high bar.

Here is what we are currently thinking:

  • A weekly newsletter that shares the biggest knowledge bombs from our community, workshops, and own research — no fluff, operational insights only.
  • A podcast and/or YouTube channel where we go deep with the best operators in eCom on how they actually grow their businesses. Not “here is our founding story” — straight to the operational meat.
  • Personal branding on LinkedIn for our founders and team members. You will build the system, develop the angles, and yes — write in other people’s voices. If ghostwriting feels beneath you, this is not your role.

You will already have a Content & Video Producer on your team, who is also happy to jump in front of the camera and take ownership beyond production. Together, you will orchestrate the content process from idea to distribution. We work AI-first - a well-set-up Claude gets you 90% of a draft; your judgment, taste, and editing get it to 100%.

2. Community & Events

The eCom Unity runs 20+ IRL events per year like our pre-OMR meetup with 150 operators and a bunch of online workshops. Two people on the team run this today, and it's largely on autopilot — your job is to guide them, connect the community to the content engine (every event is content, every discussion is a newsletter), and push the eCom Unity into its next phase as a genuine media asset.

3. Product Marketing

How we talk about Klar — our positioning, our messaging, and our anti-hype stance in a market full of hype — is something you will own and shape. You will be the strategic counterpart to Max, our founder, who is deeply opinionated on this. Your role is to challenge his perspective, sharpen our thinking, and translate a complex product into clear, compelling messaging that makes its value immediately obvious.

4. Website & Sales Collateral

You own our website (Webflow) and the collateral our sales team needs. You should be able to execute most of this yourself — with Figma, Webflow, and AI tools like Claude Code — and pull in engineering or freelancers when needed.

What success looks like after 12 months: a content machine that ships consistently and at high quality, a growing audience (newsletter, community, social) that considers Klar one of the go-to resources for eCom knowledge in Europe — and a measurable content contribution to our pipeline.

Requirements

About You

  • You are among the best at what you do - we are looking for extraordinarily talented people who are looking to take their career and knowledge to the next level. You likely have 5–10 years of experience across content, brand, or product marketing.
  • You are smart & naturally curious - existing in-depth knowledge of eCommerce would be ideal, of course, but we understand that this might be a stretch. Thus, you need to be excited to dig into new industries and gain knowledge of the brands, people and operations in it.
  • You are a great writer and editor - most content starts as words. You write excellent copy in English (German is a plus), and you have the taste to take an AI-generated draft from good to great. You know the difference.
  • You are a builder, not just a strategist - you don't need a team of ten to ship. You're comfortable in Webflow, Figma, and AI tools, and you'd rather publish this week than perfect a strategy deck.
  • You lead through others - you'll guide our community team and work with our video editor. You don't need formal authority to get people moving.
  • You optimize for learning - your main motivation at this point of your career is to learn as much as possible and broaden your tool set. You want to work with people of the same mindset and learn from each other.

Location: Munich preferred, remote possible.

Benefits

Our Offer

💰 Top-of-Market Compensation

We want to hire the best people out there to help make Klar successful, and we ensure you are compensated accordingly.

🕊️ Freedom & Impact

You will work with founders who truly "get" eCom and are super interested in your ideas. We give you the freedom you need to be successful and the space to take ownership from day one.

🎢 The Full Experience

We offer all the fun, struggle, challenge, and ultimately the elation and satisfaction that comes from building a kick-ass system. We will push you out of your comfort zone and challenge you, guaranteeing a steep personal and professional learning curve.

🔮 Massive Exposure

You get a look "behind the curtain" of how the best eCom brands operate. You will gain detailed insights into the strategies that work, backed by data from hundreds of brands.

🌍 Work From Anywhere

We are building a remote-first company. While we have a base in Munich, you have the flexibility to work from anywhere (ideally within GMT+0 to GMT+4 to keep our collaboration smooth).

🏃 Hiring Process

We are growing like crazy, so we aim to move fast - but we never compromise on quality. A normal process looks like this, but we’re happy to adapt it to your needs and ours:

📑 Application Review -> 👋🏼 First Interview -> 🧩 The Challenge -> 🧠 Deep Dive -> 🤝 Meet the Co-Founders -> 🎉 The Offer.

👋 How To Apply

Simply send your CV here or send Max a message on LinkedIn.

title: Country Director Germany (Interim 1 year)
description: Fastned is one of Europe's leading fast-charging networks. Active across 9 countries, we have spent nearly 15 years building the infrastructure, expertise and brand that defines premium fast charging in Europe. What sets us apart is our focus on reliability, sustainability and clean energy. We have been awarded “Best Charging Network” in the UK, France, Switzerland and the Netherlands, further establishing Fastned as a leading player in the field. This is your opportunity to make a lasting impact and drive change in an exciting industry of the future! Join Fastned at the forefront of Europe’s electric vehicle and charging infrastructure revolution! As our Interim Country Director , you will help accelerate the growth of the German market with our ambition to become a leading player in the EV transition. You will be instrumental in executing Fastned’s strategic vision, driving operational excellence, and nurturing a high-performing local team. This high-impact leadership role offers a unique opportunity to shape our commercial success and leave a lasting mark on the future of electric mobility. This interim role is set to start as soon as possible and will finish at the end of December 2027. Our German office is located in Cologne, you are expected to be present on location at least 3 days per week. In this role you will report directly to our COO.   What you will be doing Drive German Deployment and Operational Excellence Accelerate network deployment by proactively removing bottlenecks, ensuring rapid and strategic scaling across the market. Partner with the Country Execution Lead to drive cross-functional collaboration, ensuring our pipeline consistently delivers high-potential locations on schedule. Champion a world-class customer experience by collaborating with Local Operations to maintain pristine, high-uptime stations that exceed charging performance standards. Oversee day-to-day operations with a focus on agility, continuously refining workflows to maintain momentum and operational excellence. Elevate Commercial Performance Collaborate with commercial teams to drive revenue, customer growth, brand visibility, and local marketing. Identify opportunities, partnerships, and strategic initiatives to maximize market share and profitability. Scale B2B and B2C offerings while optimizing pricing and business models. Own the local P&L, balancing growth with cost efficiency to achieve financial targets. Represent Fastned Germany internally and externally Support the team in representing Fastned in the German EV ecosystem, incl. engaging with government bodies, stakeholders, and media to strengthen market position. Represent the German market in central decision-making, providing feedback on plans and ensuring alignment with company policies. Collaborate with legal teams to ensure regulatory compliance and risk mitigation. Shape your country strategy & execution Implement the German strategic plan, aligning with Fastned’s vision while adapting to local dynamics. Incorporate market trends, competitive shifts, and policy changes into strategic planning. Align the local team behind shared goals and continuously refine operational workflows. Manage long-term business plans and annual tactical execution across local teams. Display People & Culture Leadership   Partner with HR to recruit, develop, and retain a high-performing, mission-driven team. Lead local workforce planning, key role selection, onboarding, and leadership coaching. Cultivate a culture of collaboration, innovation, and ownership aligned with Fastned’s values. Facilitate seamless communication and alignment between local and global teams. What you bring along Proven experience in comparable senior management roles within a fast-paced, dynamic environment. Strong commercial background and expertise across B2B and B2C markets. Strong leadership skills with the ability to influence and inspire teams. Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills in both English and German. Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams. Passion for sustainability and the transition to electric mobility.   What’s in it for you? We value a healthy work-life balance, offer you genuine flexibility in your working arrangements and have established family-friendly policies. Our benefits include: 29 holidays + 2 Mission Days you can use to contribute to Fastned’s mission or to support a cause that is important to you. Flexible working hours, full travel expenses reimbursement and the IT equipment of your choice (e.g. MacBook or Dell XPS, iPhone or Android) A “Deutschlandticket” covered by Fastned Vegetarian lunch as well as snacks and drinks are provided at our office Mental wellbeing support with nilo health (one-to-one coaching, group sessions and digital tools) Urban Sports Club membership subsidised by Fastned Greater understanding of women’s health through our partnership with Flouria – you’ll have quick access to women’s health experts Team events, annual company trips and legendary Christmas parties. We would love to have a conversation with you, apply today! Since part of the interview-panel will be English speaking, we kindly ask you to share your application materials in English.  Fastned stands for equity and inclusion. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, gender identities, sexual orientations, religions, neurodiversity, disabilities, parental status or any other protected characteristic that makes you unique. raw.title: Country Director Germany (Interim 1 year)
raw.description:
Fastned is one of Europe's leading fast-charging networks. Active across 9 countries, we have spent nearly 15 years building the infrastructure, expertise and brand that defines premium fast charging in Europe. What sets us apart is our focus on reliability, sustainability and clean energy. We have been awarded “Best Charging Network” in the UK, France, Switzerland and the Netherlands, further establishing Fastned as a leading player in the field. This is your opportunity to make a lasting impact and drive change in an exciting industry of the future! Join Fastned at the forefront of Europe’s electric vehicle and charging infrastructure revolution!

As our Interim Country Director, you will help accelerate the growth of the German market with our ambition to become a leading player in the EV transition. You will be instrumental in executing Fastned’s strategic vision, driving operational excellence, and nurturing a high-performing local team. This high-impact leadership role offers a unique opportunity to shape our commercial success and leave a lasting mark on the future of electric mobility.

This interim role is set to start as soon as possible and will finish at the end of December 2027. Our German office is located in Cologne, you are expected to be present on location at least 3 days per week. In this role you will report directly to our COO. 

What you will be doing

Drive German Deployment and Operational Excellence

  • Accelerate network deployment by proactively removing bottlenecks, ensuring rapid and strategic scaling across the market.

  • Partner with the Country Execution Lead to drive cross-functional collaboration, ensuring our pipeline consistently delivers high-potential locations on schedule.

  • Champion a world-class customer experience by collaborating with Local Operations to maintain pristine, high-uptime stations that exceed charging performance standards.

  • Oversee day-to-day operations with a focus on agility, continuously refining workflows to maintain momentum and operational excellence.

Elevate Commercial Performance

  • Collaborate with commercial teams to drive revenue, customer growth, brand visibility, and local marketing.

  • Identify opportunities, partnerships, and strategic initiatives to maximize market share and profitability.

  • Scale B2B and B2C offerings while optimizing pricing and business models.

  • Own the local P&L, balancing growth with cost efficiency to achieve financial targets.

Represent Fastned Germany internally and externally

  • Support the team in representing Fastned in the German EV ecosystem, incl. engaging with government bodies, stakeholders, and media to strengthen market position.

  • Represent the German market in central decision-making, providing feedback on plans and ensuring alignment with company policies.

  • Collaborate with legal teams to ensure regulatory compliance and risk mitigation.

Shape your country strategy & execution

  • Implement the German strategic plan, aligning with Fastned’s vision while adapting to local dynamics.

  • Incorporate market trends, competitive shifts, and policy changes into strategic planning.

  • Align the local team behind shared goals and continuously refine operational workflows.

  • Manage long-term business plans and annual tactical execution across local teams.

Display People & Culture Leadership  

  • Partner with HR to recruit, develop, and retain a high-performing, mission-driven team.

  • Lead local workforce planning, key role selection, onboarding, and leadership coaching.

  • Cultivate a culture of collaboration, innovation, and ownership aligned with Fastned’s values.

  • Facilitate seamless communication and alignment between local and global teams.

What you bring along

  • Proven experience in comparable senior management roles within a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

  • Strong commercial background and expertise across B2B and B2C markets.

  • Strong leadership skills with the ability to influence and inspire teams.

  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills in both English and German.

  • Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams.

  • Passion for sustainability and the transition to electric mobility.  

What’s in it for you?

We value a healthy work-life balance, offer you genuine flexibility in your working arrangements and have established family-friendly policies. Our benefits include:

  • 29 holidays + 2 Mission Days you can use to contribute to Fastned’s mission or to support a cause that is important to you.

  • Flexible working hours, full travel expenses reimbursement and the IT equipment of your choice (e.g. MacBook or Dell XPS, iPhone or Android)

  • A “Deutschlandticket” covered by Fastned

raw.title: Computational Physicist / Scientific Software Engineer – Deep Digital Twin Development (f/m/d)
raw.description:
eleQtron develops full-stack quantum computers based on trapped-ion technology. Our approach combines laser-cooled ions, microwave and RF control, engineered magnetic field gradients, and advanced theoretical modelling to build scalable quantum processors. As our systems continue to grow in complexity and performance, predictive simulation tools are becoming a critical component for hardware development, calibration, optimisation, and fault-tolerant quantum computing. 

To strengthen our simulation and software efforts, we are looking for a Computational Physicist / Scientific Software Engineer who contributes to the Deep Digital Twin Development (f/m/d). 

Role Overview:

In this role, you will contribute to the development of a next-generation Deep Digital Twin software for trapped-ion quantum computers. You will work at the intersection of quantum technologies, numerical simulation, scientific computing, and software engineering, developing predictive models that connect microscopic physical processes to system-level performance metrics.

A key component of the position is transforming and extending existing research-grade simulation tools into a robust, scalable, and maintainable software framework. These tools will support hardware design, control optimization, system characterization, performance benchmarking, and the development of fault-tolerant quantum computing architectures.

The Deep Digital Twin is envisioned as a multi-scale simulation framework spanning several layers of abstraction, from ion trapping, control fields, and noise processes, through quantum state preparation and laser cooling to gate dynamics and reasout, ultimately interfacing with circuit-level simulators and quantum error correction workflows.

You will collaborate closely with theorists, experimental physicists, software developers, and engineers to ensure consistency between physical models, numerical simulations, and experimental observations.

Responsibilities:

  • Structure, develop and maintain a Deep Digital Twin framework for trapped-ion quantum computers, setting code and documentation standards

  • Refactor research code into robust, reusable software libraries, improving computational performance through profiling, optimization, and parallelisation

  • Contribute to software validation, benchmarking, and comparison with experimental data

  • Actively contribute to Deep Digital Twin extensions, translating physical models of trapped-ion hardware into scalable simulation tools

  • Connect Deep Digital Twin simulations to higher-level circuit simulators and quantum error correction workflows


Required skills:

  • PhD or equivalent industrial experience in Physics, Scientific Computing, Computer Science, or a related field

  • Solid understanding of quantum mechanics; background in quantum optics, atomic physics, or quantum technologies is advantageous.

  • Excellent Python programming skills and experience with scientific computing libraries (NumPy, SciPy)

  • Experience developing and maintaining scientific software projects

  • Expertise in refactoring research code into modular, maintainable software packages

  • Strong understanding of numerical methods, including linear algebra, differential equations, and optimization

  • Familiarity with software engineering best practices, including version control, testing, documentation, and code reviews

  • Familiarity with tools such as Numba, Cython, JAX, OpenMP, or similar performance optimization technologies.

  • Ability to work in an international and diverse team at the interface of theory, software, and hardware. 


We Value

  • Experience with trapped-ion quantum computing systems

  • Knowledge of open quantum systems and their simulation

  • Hands-on experience with QuTiP or similar quantum simulation frameworks

  • Experience working in high-performance computing (HPC) environments

  • Scientific software development experience in quantum technologies, AMO physics, or a related field


What you can expect from eleQtron:

  • Competitive salary: We value our team members and therefore provide remunerations that reflect this, additionally rewarding achievements

  • Flexible working hours: We offer personal freedom through a variety of flexible work schedules

  • Team spirit: In our international and diverse team, and with our regular team events, having fun at work is simply part of our culture

  • Further development: We want to grow together and so we offer our team members’ needs-based, individualized further training as well as plenty of room for personal development

  • Moving Benefits: A warm welcome! We are happy to support employees who move for us with a bonus

We believe in using space to help life on Earth.</strong></p> <p>Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.</p> <p>Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.</p> <p>As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.</p> <p>We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. They are an exemplary team leader who works with customers to make them successful users of Planet’s product offerings at a global scale.</p> <p>This role provides leadership and technical oversight for the Professional Services team, independently identifying and tackling projects that solve open-ended, ambiguous problems to lead global customer engagements to successful outcomes.</p> <p>This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our Berlin, Haarlem or London office 3 days per week.</p> <p><strong>Impact You’ll Own:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Manage a team of Professional Services Solutions architects, deployment strategists and Software Engineers.</li> <li>Apply experience in remote sensing and geospatial technologies to help Planet’s Defense and Intelligence technical oversight of multiple major projects, leading technical delivery on time and under budget.</li> <li>Plan for and execute on multiple impactful projects, work streams, and teams, identifying new opportunities that have organization-wide impact.</li> <li>Champion team processes like agile, test-driven development, and source control.</li> <li>Write technical specifications, reduce complexity, identify risks, and help the team course-correct around issues.</li> <li>Structure the team so the right people are in the right roles and plan for long-term headcount and recruiting needs to guarantee the success of the organization.</li> <li>Foster career growth of team members by taking into account their career goals and providing meaningful development experiences.</li> <li>Hold agencies where technical precision and timely delivery are critical</li> <li>Ability to work independently or collaboratively as part of a global team</li> <li>Ability to translate company goals into relevant team plans and communicate results across Engineering, Product, and Design</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Makes You Stand Out:</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience working in a technical geospatial or remote sensing role</li> <li>Experience delivering professional services to large enterprise defense and intelligence customers</li> <li>Expertise with QGIS, Esri software, GDAL, or other common geospatial software.</li> <li>Familiarity with cloud-based architectures, AI, and machine learning</li> <li>Ability to lead complex customer engagements and run workshops or training sessions with users</li> <li>A solid pulse on team engagement and a proactive retention strategy</li> <li>Active Security Clearance preferred; or the ability to obtain and maintain a clearance will make you stand out for this role</li> </ul> <p><strong>Application Deadline:</strong></p> <p>September 29, 2026 by 11:59p / 23:59 CET (Central European Time)</p> <p><strong>Benefits While Working at Planet:</strong></p> <p><em>These offerings are dependent on employment type and geographical location, based upon applicable law or company policy.</em></p> <ul> <li>Paid time off including vacation, holidays and company-wide days off&nbsp;</li> <li>Employee Wellness Program&nbsp;</li> <li>Home Office Reimbursement</li> <li>Monthly Phone and Internet Reimbursement</li> <li>Tuition Reimbursement and access to LinkedIn Learning</li> <li>Equity&nbsp;</li> <li>Volunteering Paid Time Off</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance<br></strong>Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.<strong><br></strong></p> <p><strong>Why we care so much about Belonging.&nbsp;<br></strong>We’re dedicated to helping the whole Planet, and to do that we must strive to represent all of it within each of our offices and on all of our teams. That’s why Planet is guided by an ultimate north star of Belonging—dreaming big as we approach our ongoing work.&nbsp; If this job intrigues you, but you’re thinking you might not have all the qualifications, please... do apply!&nbsp; At Planet, we are looking for well-rounded people from around the world who can contribute to more ways than just what is listed in this job description.&nbsp; We don’t just fill positions, we aspire to fulfill people’s careers, most excited about folks who are motivated by our underlying humanitarian efforts.&nbsp; We are a few orbits around the sun before we get to where we want to be, so we hope you’re excited to come along for the ride.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>EEO statement: <br></strong>Planet is committed to building a community where everyone belongs and we invite people from all backgrounds to apply.
